records.source: It's valuable but has no other purpose.
records.translation: Mahalaga ito ngunit wala nang ibang gamit.

records.source: It's a golden slab with hieroglyphs and pictures emblazoned onto the front.
records.translation: Isa itong tabletang ginto na may nakaukit na mga hiyeroglipiko at larawan sa harapan.

records.englishResidueReason: Walnut is the canonical Filipino glossary term for this progression item.

records.source: To the parrots of Ginger Island, this nut is the finest delicacy.
records.translation: Para sa mga loro ng Isla ng Luya, ang bungang ito ang pinakamasarap na pagkain.

records.source: A precious ore that can be smelted into bars.
records.translation: Mahalagang mineral na maaaring tunawin upang maging mga lingote.

records.source: Break apart to obtain gold ore.
records.translation: Basagin upang makakuha ng mineral na ginto.

records.source: A rare, delicious and savory salt.
records.translation: Bihira, masarap, at malinamnam na asin.

records.source: A speckled Mineral that is commonly used in construction.
records.translation: Batik-batik na mineral na karaniwang ginagamit sa konstruksiyon.

records.source: Plant these in the fall. Takes 10 days to grow, but keeps producing after that. Grows on a trellis.
records.translation: Itanim ang mga ito sa taglagas. Tumatagal ng 10 araw upang lumaki, ngunit patuloy na namumunga pagkatapos. Lumalaki sa balag.

records.source: You will now run a lot faster through grass and crops.
records.translation: Mas mabilis ka na ngayong makatatakbo sa damuhan at mga pananim.

records.source: Place this on your farm to start a new patch of grass.
records.translation: Ilagay ito sa Bukid upang magsimula ng bagong kumpol ng damo.

records.source: Place on the ground to create paths or to spruce up your floors.
records.translation: Ilagay sa lupa upang gumawa ng mga landas o pagandahin ang iyong mga sahig.

records.translation: Maliit at makatas na bean na malutong kapag kinagat.

records.source: A pleasant, energizing beverage made from lightly processed tea leaves.
records.translation: Kaaya-aya at nakapagpapasiglang inuming gawa sa bahagyang pinrosesong mga dahon ng tsaa.

records.translation: Patag na isdang naninirahan sa sahig ng karagatan.
